status: Frozen methods reuse; not an adoption or full issue164 disposition
limitations: Accepted teacher FIT targets carry known uncertainty: ES2007a has an approximately 0.000514 assignment margin with mixed class2/3 conditional means and only 14 strict-solo class3 bins, and its mapping is uncertain with teacher predictions conflicting with GT; ES2008a first-quarter class0 has 4 strict-solo bins with mapped means approximately [0.002, 0.745, 0.062, 0] and this early short voice is not reliably represented by the teacher.

All four FIT teacher targets were used unmodified at fixed lambda 0.25 with no confidence or source-quality masking; original GT activity/fractional/multi-active supervision was preserved and missing/support-incomplete teacher rows contributed zero KD, never zero GT. GT-preserving known noise does not license any claim that teacher errors caused the observed KD score result.

Teacher targets are future/history-conditioned and paced differently from the causal streaming student; unpaced generation is not live availability and carries no held-out generalization, translation-benefit, or student-speed claim.
Two already-exposed source-disjoint DEV prefixes totaling 244.4s support directional diagnosis only; they are not untouched evaluation and do not establish generalization.

Source-global oracle permutation is diagnostic only, not inference, calibration, or per-chunk remapping. FIT-only common-logit offsets isolate a shared activity-plus-static-slot explanation from relative-head variation and never prove voice-identity causality nor remove source/channel/time confounding.

KD selected390 is the frozen lowest-CAL-BCE checkpoint; neither total/KD loss, DEV, teacher scores, nor this diagnostic oracle selected it. This metadata amendment changes no score payload; adoption remains null.

uncertainty.teacher_effective_target_rule: (GT + 0.25 * teacher) / 1.25 on supported cells, hence GT1 targets at least 0.8 and GT0 targets at most 0.2; a loss-target property, not a guarantee about learned predictions. ES2005a quarter3 class1 mean approximately 0.471 shows conditional discrimination and the fixed 0.5 operating point are distinct.
